# TAP Protocol | Bitcoin Universe Protocol Reference

> Human docs: index.html
> Field reference: reference.html
> Network: Bitcoin
> Classification: Extendible OrdFi on Bitcoin

## Summary

An Ordinals metaprotocol with BRC-20-compatible basic token functions and extended capabilities such as authorities, mass-send, and Digital Matter Theory.

## State model

JSON text inscriptions interpreted by TAP readers, plus opt-in extended functions that can be approved by sending an inscription to yourself.

## Lifecycle

1. Token deploy
2. Mint inscription
3. Transferable
4. TAP extension

## Operations

- Token deploy: Defines a token with maximum supply and mint limit.
- Token mint: Credits a valid mint amount to the inscription owner.
- Token transfer: Creates a transferable that settles when the Ordinal is sent.
- Extended function: Adds opt-in capabilities such as authorities, mass send, and P2P flows.

## Safety

1. Basic TAP token functions mirror BRC-20-style deploy, mint, and two-step transfer behavior, but ticker rules differ.
2. Whitespace and Unicode can be valid tickers. Render and compare tickers carefully.
3. Extended functions are tappable and version-sensitive. Follow the exact function documentation and approval process.

## Sources

- TAP developer docs: https://docs.tap-protocol.com/
- TAP basic functions: https://docs.tap-protocol.com/functions/quickstart
